canonical_title: Safety-critical assembly and installation hazard prevention

versions.title_at_revision: Safety-critical assembly and installation hazard prevention
versions.text:
Standard: The air system design does not expose safety-critical systems, subsystems and assemblies to errors during installation, assembly, use, or connection. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine design requirements and drawings of safety-critical removable assemblies and components of the air system to confirm the design and incorporation of mitigations prevents damage or loss of a SCF due to errors in installation, assembly, use, or connections.
(2) Review design requirements, verification artifacts, and drawings of removable components to ensure their access for installation and maintenance prevents loss of function for associated or nearby safety-critical assemblies and components.
(3) Review design documentation to ensure that safety-critical assemblies and components can be assembled or installed without damage or loss of safety-critical functionality. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (1) Flight, Ground, or Lab test: Conduct test to verify standard maintenance and operations procedures to ensure they have no adverse effect on safety-critical systems.
